advisory.text: Air Quality Advisory: Today, May 15, 2026, the air quality in the Delhi/Karachi region (NW India + Pakistan) is unhealthy for large portions of the population, with approximately 220.7 million people exposed to such conditions. Those most at risk include the populations in northern-western, northern-eastern, and southern-eastern areas, where air quality levels are moderately poor (65 µg/m³). While cloud cover limits precise estimates for 335 million people, our estimates suggest these areas also have elevated pollutant levels. To protect your health, consider staying indoors during peak hours, using high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filters, and limiting outdoor activities if possible. Remember, these estimates, not measurements, highlight the current air quality situation.
